llm_downgrade_blocked.description: True when the LLM suggested a less acute ESI than a fired safety rule allows.
llm_downgrade_blocked.title: Llm Downgrade Blocked

lines.description: OCR lines with confidence and low flag.
lines.title: Lines

text.description: Machine output. Not clinical data until status is VERIFIED or AUTO_ACCEPTED.
text.title: Text

words.description: Transcript words with probability, low flag and auto-corrections.
words.title: Words

ConfidenceBreakdown.description: Three separate signals. They are never blended into one number.

data_completeness.description: Weighted share of vitals actually measured; capped at 0.5 if complaint-critical vitals are missing.
data_completeness.title: Data Completeness

model_probability.description: Top-class probability of the ML model (not calibrated yet).
model_probability.title: Model Probability

retrieval_confidence.description: How much of the patient's history was available; null when there is no record to retrieve.
retrieval_confidence.title: Retrieval Confidence

ConfidenceBreakdown.title: ConfidenceBreakdown

FeatureContribution.description: One TreeSHAP term: how much this input pushed the ML model toward its predicted ESI (log-odds).
FeatureContribution.title: FeatureContribution

score.description: Share of the LLM's claims fully supported by the passages they cite.
score.title: Score

low_confidence.description: True when no history passage matched the complaint confidently; only allergies, medications and problem list were used.
low_confidence.title: Low Confidence

patient_name.description: Null for roles without patient-level access.
patient_name.title: Patient Name

mrn.description: Existing MRN. Omit for a walk-in; the server assigns one.
mrn.title: Mrn

patient_name.description: Used to scrub the name from text sent to the LLM.
patient_name.title: Patient Name

request_id.description: Client-generated id. Retrying with the same id replays the original result.
request_id.title: Request Id

transcript_capture_id.description: Set when the complaint came from dictation; it must be confirmed (not PENDING_REVIEW).
transcript_capture_id.title: Transcript Capture Id

degraded.description: Pipeline stages that were unavailable, e.g. 'llm_unavailable'.
degraded.title: Degraded

final_esi.description: ESI currently assigned to the visit.
final_esi.title: Final Esi

requires_confirmation.description: True when the AI suggests a downgrade; a clinician must confirm via /api/override.
requires_confirmation.title: Requires Confirmation

security_flags.description: e.g. 'prompt_injection_suspected:D2' when instruction-like text was withheld.
security_flags.title: Security Flags

text.description: The corrected text. Omit to accept the machine text as is.

model_label_source.description: Where the ML training labels came from, e.g. 'synthetic-rules' (demo) or 'mimic-iv-ed'.
model_label_source.title: Model Label Source

post.description:
Dictation -> draft transcript + extracted symptoms/duration/severity. Retrying with the same request_id returns
the same capture (no second transcription). The audio itself is not stored.

Human override. Anyone clinical may raise acuity or lower it down to the safety-rule floor; going
below the floor needs a charge nurse or physician. Always audited with the AI's state at that moment.
